name: mgba-switch2
title: mGBA
author: endrift and the mGBA contributors; Switch 2 port by wowilookgood
description: An unofficial Switch 2 build of mGBA, the Game Boy Advance emulator.
details:
mGBA runs your own Game Boy Advance, Game Boy and Game Boy Color game dumps. This is an unofficial build of mGBA 0.10.5 for a Switch 2 running kaiHEN, not an upstream release. The emulator core is unchanged. No games are included.

The picture is 1080p docked and handheld. In a game + is Start and X opens the menu. Configuration is in /mGBA/config.ini.

Report Switch 2 problems in the fork's issues, not to upstream.
